name: Eavesdropper Ω
ability: Each day, you may privately visit the Storyteller to learn a phrase about the game.
flavor: I heard Mole and Odysseus talking about how they were going to start a gang. Said they'd call it the Gayng. Pretty cringe if you ask me.

otherNightReminder: The Journalist chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Journalist to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* info token, the Journalist token, and point to the two players marked *CHOSEN*. If the Demon chooses any tonight, wake the Journalist to learn a true statement for each chosen.
name: Journalist Ω
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: the Demon learns them. For each of these players the Demon chooses, you learn a true statement, even if dead.
flavor: I see... Well, I'm not gonna let something as silly as threat-of-death stop me from getting the truth!

otherNightReminder: Lisa Rinna might choose a player. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:
name: Lisa Rinna Ω
ability: Once per game, during the night*, choose a player: if good, they die & keep their ability. If an Outsider, they instead are drunk.

firstNightReminder: Show the *YOU ARE* info token, the Copycat character token, and a Townsfolk token. If necessary, swap their character token. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: If they die, make the in-play Townsfolk a drunk Copycat.
name: Copycat Ω
ability: On your first night, gain the ability of an in-play townsfolk: they are drunk. When you die, they become a drunk Copycat.
flavor: Stop copying me! - Satyr / Stoooop Copyiiiing Meeeee! - Orpheus

name: Realtor Ω
ability: Once per game, during the day, guess your setup effect, you learn how accurate you are. [Something bad]
flavor: This house has QUITE the history...

firstNightReminder: The Potion Seller names up to 5 potions. The Potion Seller chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Potion Seller to sleep. Wake the target. They must choose 1 potion. If this is the last potion, the Potion Seller loses their ability. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: The Potion Seller chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Potion Seller to sleep. Wake the target. They must choose 1 remaining potion. If this is the last potion, the Potion Seller loses their ability. :reminder:
name: Potion Seller Ω
ability: On your 1st night, name up to 5 potions. You may be told to reconsider. Each night, choose a player: they choose one of your potions, receiving its effect & removing the option.
flavor: I warned you, traveller. My potions would set the world on fire.
